title: Attention under Bounded Key-Query Similarity: Space Complexity and Transformer Anisotropy
abstract: arXiv:2610.35020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A growing body of work on KV-cache compression aims to reduce the memory requirements of autoregressive generation. These methods compress the stored context while approximately preserving attention computation, enabling generation with reduced memory consumption. Almost tight theoretical results on the worst case space complexity of attention have recently been obtained, but they are achieved by instances where queries can be perfectly aligned with keys. This directly contradicts the observed anisotropy of the key/query geometry in real transformers. In particular, it has been shown empirically that key/query cosine similarities are small even for most correlated pairs, i.e., near-perfect alignment of queries with keys does not happen in practice. translated_title: 有界键-查询相似性下的注意力机制：空间复杂度与Transformer各向异性
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.35020v1，公告类型：新论文）：越来越多关于KV缓存压缩的研究旨在降低自回归生成的内存需求。这些方法在近似保持注意力计算的同时压缩所存储的上下文，从而实现内存消耗更低的生成。关于注意力机制最坏情况空间复杂度的几乎紧致的理论结果近期已被获得，但这些结果是通过查询与键能够完美对齐的实例实现的。这直接与真实Transformer中观察到的键/查询几何各向异性相矛盾。特别是，已有实证研究表明，即使对于最相关的键-查询对，其余弦相似度也很小，也就是说，在实践中查询与键几乎不会实现完美对齐。在本文中，我们研究了在键/查询余弦相似度属于零附近一个小区间的假设下注意力近似的空间复杂度，即查询无法与键完美对齐……
tldr: 本文在键-查询余弦相似度有界且接近零（符合真实Transformer各向异性）的假设下研究注意力近似的空间复杂度，弥合了理论最坏情况结果与实践中KV缓存压缩之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the space complexity of attention approximation under a bounded key-query cosine similarity assumption (near zero), consistent with the observed anisotropy of real transformers, thereby bridging the gap between worst-case theoretical results and practical KV-cache compression.
